storage: Store in an airtight jar at room temperature, away from damp. Pests are the main risk; a refrigerator or freezer for a few days before storing can help (general guidance).
looksLike: Small, flat yellow split lentils; they turn soft and creamy when cooked.
howToPick: Even golden-yellow, uniform splits with no powdery dust, stones or webbing; avoid very pale, dull or oily-smelling dal (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a dry, airtight pack; check the best-before date.
mergeNotes: Range 124.6–182.0 was wider than 30% of avg 155.6; narrowed to ±15%.
